title: Victorian Big Battery: Phase 56F Coverage Decision
summary: Energy Safe Victoria states that required changes were made and it was satisfied commissioning could safely recommence on September 29, 2021. Phase 56F decision: The bounded recommissioning-action question is closed; later operating and safety outcomes remain separate.
key_findings: Highest-value missing record: Corrective-action closure after the commissioning fire.
Remaining gap: Annual availability, dispatch, cycling, degradation, later incidents, revenue, scheme activation, and customer effects.
why_it_matters: The coverage decision prevents broad context from displacing the one operating or closure record that would materially deepen the named entity.
ftfn_relevance: Preserves the stable entity ID battery-victorian-big-battery.
Separates current evidence from the missing record.
Names the exact condition that can reopen the decision.
evidence_limits: Permission to recommence commissioning does not establish later availability, dispatch, cycling, degradation, revenue, safety performance, or customer benefit.
Annual availability, dispatch, cycling, degradation, later incidents, revenue, scheme activation, and customer effects.
No causal effect, ranking, composite score, readiness score, or unsupported cross-entity comparison is supported.
